name: Wavetable Scale Stack
author: Tom Burns
description: Five scale-spaced voices over Braids Renaissance's WTx6 scan, with independent span, spread, and wavetable position.

controls.label: Span
controls.description: Sets the spacing between voices, from one scale degree up to sixteen.

controls.label: Spread
controls.description: Detunes the voices symmetrically without moving the stack's centre pitch.

controls.label: Scale
controls.description: Selects the scale whose degrees define the stack spacing.

outputs.aux: The root voice alone, as a pitch reference.
